memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Primary open-angle glaucoma, stable.
She reports mild blurring of vision in the left eye, no pain or redness. On examination, anterior chamber deep, no conjunctival injection, intraocular pressure measured 22 mmHg OD, 21 mmHg OS. Visual field shows minimal nasal step OD, disc cup-to-disc ratio 0.6 OD, 0.55 OS. Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0. Technique checked: not applicable (no respiratory disease).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
timolol 0.5% eye drops – one drop in each eye twice daily
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops – one drop in each eye at bedtime

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Intraocular pressure: OD 22 mmHg (reference 10‑21), OS 21 mmHg (reference 10‑21)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have noticed that my vision gets a little foggy in the mornings, especially when I read. It clears after a few minutes. No pain or redness.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Primary open-angle glaucoma, stable.
She denies worsening blur; occasional morning fog persists. Examination: IOP 20 mmHg OD, 19 mmHg OS, anterior chambers quiet. Visual field unchanged from last test. Disc cupping stable. Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0. Technique checked: not applicable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
timolol 0.5% eye drops – one drop in each eye twice daily
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops – one drop in each eye at bedtime

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Intraocular pressure: OD 20 mmHg (reference 10‑21), OS 19 mmHg (reference 10‑21)

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Visual field testing (Humphrey 24‑2): OD - mean deviation -0.3 dB, pattern SD within normal limits; OS - mean deviation -0.2 dB, pattern SD within normal limits. No new defects.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Primary open-angle glaucoma, mild progression.
She reports increased morning fog lasting up to 30 minutes, mild glare sensitivity. Examination: IOP 24 mmHg OD, 23 mmHg OS, mild corneal edema OD. Disc cup-to-disc ratio 0.62 OD, 0.58 OS. Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0. Technique checked: not applicable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
timolol 0.5% eye drops – one drop in each eye twice daily
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops – one drop in each eye at bedtime
brimonidine 0.1% eye drops – one drop in each eye three times daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Intraocular pressure: OD 24 mmHg (reference 10‑21), OS 23 mmHg (reference 10‑21)

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Optic disc assessment (stereo photos): OD cup-to-disc ratio 0.62, rim thinning inferiorly; OS ratio 0.58, mild inferior rim thinning. No hemorrhages.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Primary open-angle glaucoma, controlled on triple therapy.
She reports morning fog resolved, only occasional mild glare. Examination: IOP 18 mmHg OD, 17 mmHg OS, anterior chambers quiet, no corneal edema. Visual field stable. Disc cupping unchanged. Smoking status: never smoked, pack-years 0. Technique checked: not applicable.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
timolol 0.5% eye drops – one drop in each eye twice daily
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops – one drop in each eye at bedtime
brimonidine 0.1% eye drops – one drop in each eye three times daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Intraocular pressure: OD 18 mmHg (reference 10‑21), OS 17 mmHg (reference 10‑21)
